meta.focus: Content-Only (Articles, Scripts, Landing Pages, Emails, Shorts)

cialdini_principles.social_proof: Weave numbers, reviews, expert quotes near claims and CTAs
cialdini_principles.authority: Cite credible experts, studies, and institutions inline
cialdini_principles.reciprocity: Deliver quick wins and practical takeaways before asking
cialdini_principles.liking_unity: Reflect audience identity, shared language, and values
cialdini_principles.scarcity_ethical: Only when verifiably true; otherwise emphasize uniqueness/fit

fogg_behavior_model.motivation: Highlight outcomes that matter now; vivid before/after
fogg_behavior_model.ability: Give simple next steps; remove friction (1-click save, short form)
fogg_behavior_model.prompt: Explicit, timely calls to action within narrative

framing: Use comparison language for missed benefits

copy_structures.aida: Attention (Headlines) -> Interest (Why now) -> Desire (Vivid outcomes) -> Action (Single clear action)
copy_structures.pas: Problem (Name it) -> Agitate (Intensify stakes) -> Solution (Practical fix)

narrative_transportation.goal: Absorb readers, tie resolution to actionable steps

principles: Antidotes to F-pattern (headings, front-loaded sentences, bullets)

means_end_ladders.flow: Feature -> Functional Outcome -> Emotional Benefit -> Identity/Values

jobs_to_be_done.approach: Write to the job, surface anxieties, show desired progress

aida_short_form.interest: Most people waste weeks on [problem]. Here’s the 10-minute shortcut.

pas_medium_form.problem: When you’re trying to [job], [pain] keeps you stuck.
pas_medium_form.solution: Do X in 3 steps to get [outcome]—backed by [authority/social proof].

templates.story_block: Character & Goal -> Obstacle -> Specific action -> Outcome -> Lesson -> CTA

microcopy_examples.loss_aversion: Don’t lose this week’s momentum—save your plan in 1 click.
microcopy_examples.social_proof: 12,487 people with [problem] used this in the last 90 days.
microcopy_examples.reciprocity: Grab the quick-start checklist—free, no login.
